**Finding: Compliant** (preferred position met)

The agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks. Searches for the usual triggers ("solicit", "induce", "employ", "hire") surfaced nothing restrictive — only the Applicable Law definition and the insurance clause. § 12.3 goes further in our favour, expressly preserving our right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and recording that we have made no no-hire commitment. No redline proposed.
